subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “A debate is not only about winning.”?
options: A device's shape tells a story about what its makers think matters.
It was about learning why the trash was there.
It is about learning how a reasonable person can think differently from you.
It also shows that someone has thought about the person using it.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「A device's shape tells a story about what its makers think matters.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「It was about learning why the trash was there.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「A debate is not only about winning. It is about learning how a reasonable person can think differently from you.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「It also shows that someone has thought about the person using it.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「A debate is not only about winning. It is about learning how a reasonable person can think differently from you.」，答案為「It is about learning how a reasonable person can think differently from you.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「It is about learning how a reasonable person can think differently from you.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
